hooks.text: Four astronauts will fly 252,756 miles to break Apollo 13's record.
Which mission travels farther from Earth than any flight in history?
Humanity will break Apollo 13's record by traveling 252,756 miles.

title: The Mission Breaking Apollo 13’s Distance Record
description: NASA's Artemis II mission will send four astronauts 252,756 miles from Earth, breaking a record held for over fifty years.

beats.text: Four astronauts will fly 252,756 miles to break Apollo 13's record.
beats.visual: Illustration of the Orion spacecraft in deep space near the Moon, 2026
queries: Artemis II Orion deep space illustration

beats.text: Slated for 2026 aboard NASA's Space Launch System, Artemis II will push farther into deep space than humans have ever traveled.
beats.visual: Space Launch System rocket launching from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center, 2026

beats.text: Commander Reid Wiseman and pilot Victor Glover will guide the Orion spacecraft Integrity on this ten-day flight.
beats.visual: Artist rendering of Orion spacecraft Integrity flying through deep space, 2026

beats.text: ESA's European Service Module provides the power to loop the crew around the lunar far side.
beats.visual: European Service Module attached to Orion spacecraft in deep space, 2026

beats.text: Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen join Victor Glover as the first woman, non-American, and Black astronaut to fly around the Moon.
beats.visual: Official portrait of the Artemis II crew at Ellington Field, 2023

beats.text: While Apollo 13 reached its record during a crisis, Artemis II will reach it as a planned trial run.
beats.visual: Photograph of the damaged Apollo 13 service module in space, 1970

beats.text: After splashing down in the Pacific, this flight will reset the record for the farthest humans have ever traveled.
beats.visual: Orion capsule floating in Pacific Ocean during recovery operations off San Diego, 2026

better_than_last: Applied stricter word-count management to accommodate the lengthy pronunciation of the distance record while maintaining a seamless grammatical loop between the final beat and the hook.
